page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running heading at the top; two diagrams (paired globe figures with letters Z, B, C, K, G, F, D, H, A) set in the middle of the page below the text; a catchword "Vmbram" and signature "R 2" at the foot right. No margin notes. A red manuscript mark at the top right margin is not printed text.

main_text.l: quouis anno Sol bis fit uerticalis. Paralleli enim quos puncta
in duobus punctis secant. Quare umbras illi
meridianas nullas habent sole puncta intersectionum occupant-
e. Rursus ad Austrum procidunt eædem, cum se-
quod puncta illa auellunt, permeat. Contra in boream proten-
transcurrit. Sed sub Tropico æstiuo uersantibus Sol semel
tantum fit uerticalis, quod Parallelus ille Eclipti-
cam in uno tantum puncto contingit.

page.notes: The diagrams are not transcribed as text. Red manuscript marks in the margins are excluded. Spelling kept as printed: "Ecipticam" and "Eclipti-" as printed; the first line of the paragraph is set in large type; the running line "cam in uno tantum" is the continuation of the text across the figure.
